subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired version of this delivery-ordering fix, or leave the dirty draft waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug is real and the proof is strong, but the current branch needs non-trivial owner-boundary repair around canonical lane derivation and stalled sends before it can land.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

options.title: Wait For Contributor
options.body: Keep the draft open but require the contributor to rebase and address the existing findings before another merge-readiness review.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-main routing candidate for the outbound delivery and keyed queue boundaries touched by the repair.
